title.narrative: Ecoality: Youth and Local Authorities together for climate and gender justice

description.narrative:
The Action will adopt an intersectional approach to promote

- the importance of everyone embracing crosscutting principles and values such as care, participation, non-violence, inclusion;

- Transforming mind-sets, skills, attitudes, actions, which are sensitive to both gender and ecological equalities and

- Examining relationships (power and privilege) between people and between people and the planet, which help and hinder sustainable development.
